title: Preserve Seeded Dialog Context Arguments
description: Achieve end to end: running `s` with running plugins; hub with persistence for spaces and live presence between all users in the same app/viewer/editor; the home app of s is an overview table with all spaces (create, open, delete); the space app is a table with all artifacts (create, open, delete); studios sharable for collaborative editing; artifacts opened in a viewer or an editor; when a user edits an artifact the mutations are saved and checked into vcs; new dev configs for s user 1 and user 2 running on different ports connecting to the same hub, with user1 + user2 + hub running simultaneously; hub admin page showing all spaces, allowing management, and showing active connections. Both React and wgpu shells in scope. Directory is an append-only event log with SQL projections and a live /directory/ws stream. Admin page served by the hub binary at /admin. Master plan: 📋️master-plan.md in this ticket folder.
summary:
Built the collaborative-studio stack end to end across 23 Sonnet worker lanes and 5 Haiku scouts/audits in 6 coordinated waves, with a barrier and honest evidence gate between each. Full detail in 📓️final-summary.md plus 40 lane reports and ~200 raw logs in the ticket folder.

DELIVERED. Hub: the directory is now an append-only event log (hub_directory_event) with SQL projections, a pure decide()/DirectoryService command path and rebuild_projections replay — the CRUD write methods are gone with no compat shim, per CLAUDE.md. On top of it: POST /directory/commands, GET /directory/spaces|events, a gap-free subscribe-then-replay /directory/ws, invites, /auth/sessions/me, and a full /admin/api surface (overview, spaces, users, connections, documents, events, rebuild, kick, revoke). Presence is scoped (space, document, surface) via ?surface= out of band — a viewer and an editor on the same document no longer share a roster, while command frames still fan out document-wide. A React admin SPA (nx os-hub-admin, en+de) is served by the hub binary at /admin. Client: a new os.config.identity facet with sign-in/sign-out triads, Rust and TS DirectoryClients with resume-from-seq reconnect, automatic hub+folder binding of every opened document, actor ids of the form user:{id}#{session}, directory relays as os.directory.* host effects with offline queueing, a Home app that is a real table of spaces and a new plugin-owned s.space artifact that is a real table of a space's artifacts (create/open/delete/rename/share, members panel), a PresenceBar element in both shells, and a save/check-in policy (auto on idle or volume, explicit #s-checkin, on close, status pill, TouchArtifact). Dev: a users dimension in the playground registry generates 👤️1/👤️2 launchers for react (6072/6073) and wgpu (6067/6068), a hub+both-users compound, an admin launcher (8790) and a collab-e2e gate; a plugin-build lease lets the second dev process serve the first one's modules so both users genuinely run at once. The hub port collision with s on 6070 is resolved (hub is 8787 everywhere).

VERIFIED. semio-hub 11/0 lib and 18/0 bin; semio-s-plugin-space 210/0 (it did not even link at the start of the ticket); semio-framework-os-kernel 988/0; wgpu renderer compiles (0 errors, first time this ticket) with 314/2; semio-s-plugin-space builds to wasm32-wasip2 and produces its .wasm; HUB_E2E=1 os-hub-ts:test passes a 7-step scenario against the real hub binary including a process restart proving persistence; os-hub-admin 5/5; plugin-registry check green with launch.json fresh.

BUGS FIXED THAT WERE BLOCKING THE WHOLE PRODUCT, NOT JUST THIS TICKET. EditorApp/ViewerApp reported a placeholder APP_ID of "surface" that a live ownership check compared literally, so every button click on every editor/viewer surface in the repo was silently rejected. The hub sent no CORS headers at all while hub and shells are different origins by design, so browser sign-in could never succeed. TableWindowKit serialized rows as bare positional arrays the renderers cannot read, breaking every such table in the repo. A checkpoint taken after edits arrived over the hub was rejected as an invalid edit reference, and every checkpoint was authorless. semio-s-plugin-space could not compile to wasm at all (tokio/net reaching wasm through os-host-full). Nine of eleven worker.postMessage sites in ShellHost posted unencoded objects, throwing TypeError in both shells. The hub dev script replaced process.env wholesale and had a broken import path. PluginBuilder::document_app carried an unnecessary SemanticMutation bound. Seeded dialog args were dropped before dispatch; the vite dev entry 404'd on any hard navigation to a nested route; the /spaces/{id} route branch lacked an idempotency guard and reopened its document forever.

NOT DONE, PLAINLY. The browser end-to-end passes 2 of 8 steps: STEP 1 (user1 creates a space, user2's Home shows it) and STEP 7 (admin connections and /admin HTML). It went 0/8 with nothing rendering, to buttons reachable, to surface dispatch unblocked, to 1/8, to 2/8; every unreached step carries its real failure text. The next blocker is diagnosed — a plugin-instance-busy / missing HistorySnapshot retry storm in PluginRuntime — but that file is currently being rewritten by a concurrent peer session, so lane 4-I stopped rather than edit it mid-flight. Postgres and neo4j directory backends are written to parity but have never been compiled, because the 🛢️db crate declares its sqlite/postgres/neo4j features empty with no drivers wired (pre-existing since 2026-08-12, peer-owned); consequently every hub lane verified with default features and os-hub:test* is unusable since it hardcodes --all-features. The wgpu shell's collaboration wiring is compiler-verified and unit-tested but never observed running; auto check-in, checkpoint-on-close and TouchArtifact are React-only because the native shell has no uncommitted-edit tracking. Five semio-framework-plugin and two wgpu renderer test failures remain, each attributed by commit and date to FULL-STDIO (still open) or to work predating this ticket. Thirteen of 33 plugin crates still fail to build for wasm, each attributed individually. verify gate still fails at dependency-cruiser exactly as it did before this ticket, with the baseline captured — no new failing step.

PROCESS. Two independent audits found zero lease violations and zero unbacked claims: every claimed pass has a matching log, and every lane that could not finish something said so. 🗄️stdio and 📜️world.wit were never touched while FULL-STDIO remains open; the 🏪️store and 🔌️plugin work was taken up only after the MUTATION-OUTCOMES ticket closed at 02:44 and released its leases. CLAUDE.md was audited specifically on event-sourcing with no CRUD or CRDT, no compat layers, schema-first Rust/TS twins, region structure, emoji docstrings, one script.ts per bundle, and en+de on every user-visible string — all clean.
